sentences.text:
Counsel for Applicant :- Mohammad Raza Khan
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Pankaj Bhatia,J.
1.

Heard learned counsel for the applicant, learned AGA and perused the record.
2. The applicant seeks enlargement on bail in FIR No.131 of 2024, under Section 498A, 304B, 323,
506 IPC & Section 3/4 of D.P. Act, P.S. Kotwali Nagar, District Balrampur.
3. Learned counsel for the applicant argues that co-accused i.e. father-in-law has been enlarged on bail vide order dated 02.08.2024.
4. Learned AGA has opposed the bail application.
5. Considering the fact that co-accused has been enlarged on bail, the applicant is entitled to be enlarged on bail on the ground of parity.
In view thereof, the application is allowed.

6. Let the applicant Shaheen Khan @ Shaheen Jahan be released on bail in aforesaid FIR number on her furnishing a personal bond with two sureties of Rs.20,000/- each to the satisfaction of court concerned with the following conditions:
